Roborock Qrevo S replacement parts.

U.S. Roborock Qrevo S robot model QX1PEC and its multifunctional dock. The robot model is printed in the manual; check the model name in the app and the bag compartment before ordering.

Check the variant: Qrevo S is not the original Qrevo / 2R3W, Qrevo S5V, Qrevo Pro, or Qrevo S Pro. In particular, its washable filter is a different part from the original Qrevo filter. Shared compatibility for bags, mop cloths, or one brush does not make complete kits interchangeable.

Washable dustbin filters ↓Single main roller brush ↓Black side brushes ↓Round spinning mop cloths ↓Multifunctional dock dust bags ↓

Roborock Qrevo S replacement filters

Two washable filters.

View filters on Amazon ↗

Fit: Roborock's U.S. product page names Qrevo S for this two-filter product. It is the washable filter inside the robot dustbin, not a dock dust-bag filter.

Replace when: Roborock says to clean this filter every 2 weeks and replace it every 6–12 months, or sooner if it is damaged or remains clogged after cleaning and drying.

Before buying: Choose the listing that explicitly includes Qrevo S. Do not use the original Qrevo / 2R3W filter or a filter for another Qrevo just because the family name looks similar. After rinsing, let the filter dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling it.

What is shared, and what needs checking?

Filter
Qrevo S uses the Roborock washable filter product that explicitly names Qrevo S. Do not substitute the first-generation Qrevo / 2R3W filter.
Main brush
Qrevo S uses the conventional single full-width roller listed by Roborock for Qrevo S. DuoDivide assemblies are different.
Side brush
Roborock lists the black two-piece side-brush product for Qrevo S. Match the brush color and screw mount.
Mop cloths
The round spinning cloths are a separate consumable from their plastic mounts; confirm the cloth shape and attachment.
Dock bag
Choose the listing's “White-Qrevo Dust Bags” variation and verify Qrevo S in the details. A product option named Qrevo S Pro alone does not prove compatibility.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock Qrevo S maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock Qrevo S cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
Main brushEvery 2 weeks6–12 months
Side brushMonthly3–6 months
Washable filterEvery 2 weeks6–12 months

Roborock requires a rinsed washable filter to dry for at least 24 hours before reinstallation. Clear hair from the roller and side brush during routine cleaning, and switch off the robot before servicing it.

Before you order

Does the original Roborock Qrevo filter fit Qrevo S?

Do not assume so. Roborock lists a separate washable-filter product for Qrevo S, and the first-generation Qrevo filter listings can exclude Qrevo S. Match the exact model in the listing.

Does the Qrevo S use a DuoDivide main brush?

No. Roborock lists the conventional single main brush for Qrevo S. DuoDivide is a different assembly used by select newer models, including Qrevo S5V and Curv/Edge family models.

Are these all genuine Roborock parts?

The washable filter and black side-brush listings are Roborock branded. The roller, mop cloths and dock bags are third-party products, labeled separately; DustMigo has not physically tested their fit or performance.

How often should I replace Qrevo S consumables?

Roborock's Qrevo S manual recommends replacing the main brush and washable filter every 6–12 months, the side brush every 3–6 months and mop cloths every 1–3 months. Replace dock bags as required and follow the robot's indicator.
